old: ## **7. Cross-Border Data Transfers**

new: ### **7. Cross-Border Data Transfers**

Because we operate a global service, the sharing of your data laid out in Section 5 involves cross-border data transfers to our Affiliates and service providers (other third parties) in third countries that have different privacy laws.. When we transfer personal data to a third country, we use appropriate mechanisms. For example, we rely on:

- Adequacy decisions issued by the <u>European Commission</u> or other competent authorities under applicable laws. We transfer personal data to our Affiliates to perform important functions, as outlined in Section 6, by storing, accessing or otherwise processing data and to third- parties in countries with adequacy decisions for the purposes outlined in Section 5.

- <u>Standard contractual clauses</u> issued by the European Commission or similar contractual data transfer mechanisms approved by other competent authorities under applicable laws. These contractual data transfer mechanisms are commitments between companies transferring personal data, binding them to protect the confidentiality and security of your data and ensuring adequate level of protection in third countries. We rely on such mechanisms to transfer personal data to our Affiliates to perform important functions, as outlined in Section 6, by storing, accessing or otherwise processing data, and to third parties for the purposes outlined in Section 5 in countries without adequacy decisions, such as the United States of America. <u>Contact us</u> for a copy.
## **8. Your Rights**

We want you to be in control of your data, so we want to remind you of the following rights, options and tools available to you. Depending on where you live, these rights may not apply to you or they may be named differently. If you have any questions on your rights and how to exercise them, please contact us <u>here.</u>
